prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Card Selection Redesign for Path Choice: Redesign the path selection screen into a clear card layout showcasing available pet journey types. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a high mean time of 514 seconds, indicating decision hesitation.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Pet Cloud Persistence Guarantee Notice: Add an explicit data safety hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that pet progress persists to their cloud account. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Trait Customizer Screen: Add a new customization preview screen before final certificate signing where users select pet personality traits. (why: Adoption has a 31.1% drop-off rate and 1017s mean duration, showing a need for higher engagement before certificate issuance.)
3: [home, wait_info] Estimated Render Time Indicator on Waiting Screen: Display estimated render time and a visible progress bar during pet desktop initialization on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting stage has a mean time of 2336s and 3 users reported pets not showing up on the desktop.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Overlay Controls Flow: Introduce a dedicated overlay guide screen showing desktop keyboard shortcuts for hiding, summoning, and interacting with the pet. (why: Multiple support emails cited confusion about controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding.)
5: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Welcome Screen Redesign: Redesign the home introduction screen into a full-bleed layout featuring an animated pet mascot welcome. (why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% (64.8% conversion) with high mean completion time.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Desktop Readiness Notification Switch: Add a readiness notification toggle on the sign-in screen to alert users when their account sync finishes. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or not appearing.)
